title: docs: teach os mcp connect and the use-runtime deploy target in the remaining pages
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xLF4QmNSimbBfXVa9LZxfqG)_

Fixes #31235

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

`dispatch-gates --tier` reads a contract-review model mandate for `skills/**` (clause ①). That mandate is waived by the maintainer's standing order in this project (2026-11-03). This card ran on the project's default model, and the dispatching seat (domain:skills#3) runs the contract review.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：三个文档页与平台技能跟上 PR #31225 已发布的 CLI。`ai/agents.mdx` 的 Claude Code 行和 `build-with-claude-code.mdx` 的连接步骤先教 `os mcp connect`（自托管或本地用 `--url <base>`），手敲的 `claude mcp add` 留作没有 CLI 时的备选，无头 `--header` 写法不变；`deployment/cli.mdx` § `os dev` 说明 `d` 键只在云目标下先跑 `os cloud login`，`use-runtime` 目标直接部署到该运行时、不要云登录；`operations.md` 的 `os deploy` 退出码 1 段限定为云路径，新增一段写 `use-runtime` 目标的退出码 1 情形。
- 为什么改：这几处仍只教旧路径，照着做的作者会手敲 CLI 已经替他执行的命令，还会以为自托管部署需要云登录（#31235，来自 #31225 契约复核第 9 项与 N8）。
- 风险与回滚：纯文档与技能文字，不动代码；`operations.md` 先删同文件重复内容（-262 字节），余额 +35 tokens 按常设裁定 6513306068 抬高该行棘轮（3340 → 3375）；发版 `@objectstack/skills` patch；回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md` L95–L102；然后 `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` L169–L174。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`（3375 / 3375）；对照 `packages/cli/src/commands/deploy.ts` L301–L355 读新段的每个退出情形；`packages/cli/src/utils/dev-deploy-key.ts` L26–L30 读 `d` 键不要云登录。
- 需要你做的：`check-governed-merges` 判为 Tier H（`skills/**`），需 `os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 批准；当前 head 尚无席位契约复核 PASS，契约复核待做，请先不要批。

## What changes

### The four sites, before and after

| Site | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` L99, Claude Code row | only the typed `claude mcp add --transport http objectstack https://<your-deployment>/api/v1/mcp`, with the headless `--header` alternative | names `os mcp connect` first (your ObjectOS Cloud environment) and `os mcp connect --url <base>` (a self-hosted or local server, registered as `objectstack`); the typed line stays as the fallback "Without the CLI"; the headless `--header` alternative stays, attached to the typed line, with the reason (`os mcp connect` stores no token) |
| `content/docs/getting-started/build-with-claude-code.mdx` L477, L480 | two typed `claude mcp add … support-desk …` lines (local, deployed) | `npx os mcp connect --url http://localhost:3000` (the step-5 dev server), `npx os mcp connect` and `npx os mcp connect --url https://your-deployment.example.com` (a deployed instance); one sentence links `os mcp connect` and says it stores no token; the two typed lines follow as the fallback, byte-identical. L502 (now L511, the headless `--header` form) is unchanged |
| `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` § `os dev` L169-L172 | "when you are not logged in to ObjectOS Cloud the same key runs `os cloud login` first" | the cloud login is for a cloud target; with a runtime [`os environments use-runtime`](#deploy-to-a-self-hosted-runtime) remembered, the key deploys there and asks for no cloud login |
| `skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md` L100 | one `os deploy` exit-1 paragraph, all cloud-path refusals | that paragraph is scoped "exit 1, cloud", and a new paragraph gives the `use-runtime` target's path and exit-1 cases (below) |

`npx os` matches the page's own step 5 (`npx os dev --ui`, L361). No `--name support-desk`: no later step on the page uses the server's name (the only other `support-desk` server line is the headless alternative at L511, a separate registration), so the CLI's own names stand.

### The new operations.md paragraph, and where each case comes from

```diff
-**`os deploy` exit 1:** a refusal before any write publishes nothing: …
+**`os deploy` exit 1, cloud:** a refusal before any write publishes nothing: …
+
+**A `use-runtime` target** (no `--env`) asks for no cloud login: build, dry-run plan, install, live on `hotLoaded`. Exit 1: a failed build; a dry run refused, unserved (no install-local) or ignored (an older runtime installed: upgrade it); an install refusal (rerun with the `--confirm-access-upgrade` / `--confirm-upgrade <token>` it printed); installed but not loaded (live after a restart).
```

| Case | `cli.mdx` § To a self-hosted runtime | Source on `main` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| no `--env`, no cloud login | L3253-L3255, L3274-L3275 | `deploy.ts` L162-L166 (`flags.env ? undefined : activeRuntimeTarget()`); `dev-deploy-key.ts` L26-L30 |
| failed build | step 1 | `deploy.ts` L310-L314 |
| dry run refused or unserved | step 2 | `deploy.ts` L329-L334 |
| dry run ignored by an older runtime, which installed | step 2 | `package/install.ts` L545-L561 (`does not support a dry run: it ignored --dry-run and INSTALLED`); then `deploy.ts` L330-L334 exits 1 |
| install refusal, `--confirm-access-upgrade` / `--confirm-upgrade` | step 3 (names only `--confirm-access-upgrade`) | `deploy.ts` L140-L155 (both flags), L337-L344 |
| installed but not loaded | not listed | `deploy.ts` L346-L352 ("it loads when the runtime restarts") |

## Token readings (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, tokens = ceil(bytes / 4))

| File | `main` 604a2b3b9 | This PR | Ceiling |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md` | 13360 B = 3340 | 13500 B = 3375 | 3340 → 3375 |

The order read 3285 / 3287; the seat re-measured 3340 / 3340 on `main` (PR #31225 raised the row) and that reading stands.

**Deletions, each with its surviving home (-262 bytes):**

1. The `os deploy` row's tail "A `use-runtime` target, no `--env`: build, dry-run plan, install, live on `hotLoaded`; `--confirm-access-upgrade <token>`" becomes "A `use-runtime` target: below" (-92 B). Facts it held: the use-runtime target applies with no `--env`; the sequence build, dry-run plan, install, live on `hotLoaded`; `--confirm-access-upgrade <token>`. Home: the new paragraph two lines down, which carries every one of them.
2. The Common ops pitfalls row "A permission set is declared but grants nobody anything | Declaring a set is not assigning it — see "Assigning a permission set to a user" in **objectstack-data**." (-170 B). Facts it held: the symptom, declaring is not assigning, the pointer. Home: `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` § Assigning a permission set to a user (L35-L37: "Declaring a set grants nobody anything — an assignment is **data**"). No script, test or platform eval pins it.

Added: +402 B (the ", cloud" scope and the new paragraph). Net +140 B → 3375 tokens, remainder +35 over the 0-headroom ceiling. Only that row moves, pinned at the measurement, under the standing ruling quoted in the script beside it: maintainer ruling 2026-10-27, verbatim and untranslated, 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 (ruling record 6513306068 on #27847). The seat ruled on these cuts and the +35 before the script was touched. No rewrap: every untouched line is byte-identical to `main`.

## Eval cases

`skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` swept for "hand-typed only" and "deploy needs a cloud login": **none touched.**

- Case 17 asks how to see an edit "on my ObjectOS Cloud environment"; its "log in with `os cloud login`" is right for that cloud-only prompt.
- Case 21 (use-runtime) and case 22 (`os mcp connect`) already teach the new paths; their `must_not_contain` (`os deploy --url`, `--client cursor`) do not contradict their `expected_output`.

## Other sites found (not edited)

- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` § `os deploy` flag table (≈L3240-L3246) lists `--confirm-access-upgrade` but not `--confirm-upgrade` (`deploy.ts` L149-L155, added by #31243); § To a self-hosted runtime step 3 (L3267) names only `--confirm-access-upgrade`, and step 4 (L3270) omits the not-loaded exit 1 (`deploy.ts` L346-L352).
- `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` case 21 `expected_output` names only `--confirm-access-upgrade`. Not an old-claim case; left alone.
- `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx` L45, L48, L68: typed `claude mcp add` lines, already under "Or type the line yourself" after `os mcp connect` (L27-L38). Already the order's shape.
- `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` L108 (private-deployment callout): "**Claude Code** (`claude mcp add`, or the plugin) dials the endpoint from your own machine". Still true, since `os mcp connect` runs that line.
- No other "deploy needs `os cloud login`" claim in `content/docs/**` or `skills/**`. `cli.mdx` L3216 (`os cloud login  # once per machine`) is the cloud example in § `os deploy`, correct for that path.
- Left alone by order: `content/docs/releases/v16.mdx` L76, L468; blog posts; CHANGELOGs.

## Changeset

`.changeset/31235-platform-skill-use-runtime-deploy-exit.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, with `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 88 commands against merge base `604a2b3b9`. All 88 ran on head `a082087b` after a full `pnpm build` (exit 0), under `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`: **88 × exit 0, 0 NOT MEASURED** among the listed commands. The CI-only families dispatch-gates names as not locally measurable (shard attestation, Build Core / Build Docs steps, type-check lanes) are left to CI.

The order's named checks are all in that list and exit 0: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples`, `pnpm check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-refs`, `pnpm check:doc-authoring`, `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (operations.md 3375 / 3375). Also `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` exit 0 and `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD` exit 0 (Tier H). Per-command record: project file `card-31235/gates-a082087b.txt`.
